meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 Git 历史：自动识别提交、变基、历史查询等任务，按规则执行原子提交、重写历史或回答谁/何时/为什么改了代码的问题。
howto.when: 当你要求操作 Git 历史（如提交、变基、查看谁改了某行代码）时触发。不用于普通代码编辑，除非你明确提到 Git 相关操作。

say.text: 帮我提交当前修改，分成两个原子提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析改动，按功能分组提交。

say.text: 谁改了这个文件？用 git blame 查一下。
say.note: Claude 会运行 git blame 并报告最后修改者。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式变基并 squash。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can manage Git history: automatically identify commit, rebase, or history queries, execute atomic commits, rewrite history, or answer who/when/why changed code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to operate on Git history (e.g., commit, rebase, find who changed a line). Not used for ordinary code edits unless you mention Git.

say_en.text: Commit my current changes in two atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes and group by feature.

say_en.text: Who last modified this file? Use git blame.
say_en.note: Claude runs git blame and reports the last modifier.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude performs interactive rebase with squash.
